paraphrase: There is liberation for women as for men, for the cause of liberation — the three jewels — is present in them without deficiency, and nothing in a woman is opposed to the three jewels. Women can hold right faith, learn scripture, keep the great vows and practise austerity; the garment they keep is not possession, for possession is attachment; that women cannot be reborn in the lowest hell does not show that they cannot reach the highest state; and the scripture itself speaks of women who reached liberation.
speaker: Śākaṭāyana
notes: A composite paraphrase of the opening verses and the main arguments (moderate confidence on the order); translated in P. S. Jaini, Gender and Salvation (1991).
